request.subject: UNIT:MARTIAN:GUARD

layers.text: Add only one thing: a short dark gunmetal mast on his back that holds one small round silver dish emitter with a glowing hot magenta centre just above and behind the top left of his helmet, in place of the antenna. Do not redraw anything else: keep the big round chrome shield with its magenta lens and arc, his head, helmet, shoulder plates, legs, size, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
